setting: Sentence-level lip reading / VSR / AVSR decoders (the 633-study population of the shared sentence-level regex, filtered to 77 prior decoders after removing perception, neuroscience, corpus, enhancement and review papers and version duplicates) for the M02 usual approach; novelty precedents over the whole wiki in any signal (full-text distillation recall before 2020-06). M12: decoders reporting visual-only LRS2 error rates.

inherited.M01: Overt speech video with paired audio; length curriculum and scheduled sampling (WAS lineage)
inherited.M03: Teacher ASR trained on benchmark audio plus AISHELL or LibriSpeech; KD weights by grid search; LRS2 visual front end pretrained on MV-LRS
inherited.M04: Overt speech; muted video at test
inherited.M06: WAS attention sequence-to-sequence lip reader (Chung et al. 2017)
inherited.M07: Beam width 1 (CMLR) or 4 (LRS2); external LM use not stated
inherited.M08: Characters: 1,779 Chinese characters or 26 English letters
inherited.M11: Provided CMLR and LRS2 partitions; no speaker-overlap statement
inherited.M13: No device, latency or cost figures

topics.inclusion_rule: Published rule (video-only test, paired audio or a speech model used in training by distillation, audio-feature regression or audio memory). For this review the design comparison is restricted to the 77 prior sentence-level decoders and the 17 [concurrent] ones, classified by full-text pattern (reference list removed) and snippet reading: speech-recognizer teacher outputs or features distilled into the video model (same design), audio-feature regression, audio forced-alignment labels as training targets; plus whole-wiki recall for a distillation term with a non-acoustic signal term before 2020-06. Boundary: audio-visual students that need audio at test are counted separately; corpus construction by subtitle alignment and mentions are not designs.
topics.metric: CMLR CER, LRS2 CER/WER; gain over the same model without distillation

topics.inclusion_rule: Studies that report visual-only (lip-reading) CER or WER on the LRS2 test set, any training regime. Boundary: audio-only and audio-visual rows, keyword spotting and corpus papers are excluded on reading; versions once. Compared: run repetition (seeds, repeated runs, spread) and whether cross-paper tables match LM, training data and decoding.
topics.pattern: LRS2 and lip reading / VSR / visual-only and WER/CER in the ledger text
